semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in CMP equipment essential for semiconductor wafer processing.
summary: Hangzhou Sizone Electronic Technology Inc. focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-end chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) equipment. They provide advanced technology and services to the semiconductor industry, particularly in the production of 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch wafers.
capabilities: Cleaning and drying equipment for substrates

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Hangzhou, China, and has developed a strong domestic presence in semiconductor equipment manufacturing.
